g.text: AI06 - Prolog obtains business data through HTTP
Current Manager/session and record-access checks belong to the caller.
Register fixed selection / claim input lease
Invoke Prolog with selectors and scheduling context
Stored document, selection and snapshot ID
[Current catalogue, stock or receipt source selected]
BEGIN REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; pin snapshot
View ID, revision, demand and provenance
[Selected products, sizes, configurations, recipes, stock and AI02 pending deliveries]
Raw selected reads on the same connection, when current
Records with same view ID and revision
Resolve components and follow produced recipes
Read selected products' offers from confirmed version
ROLLBACK and release transient read connection
Validate candidate and map to Prolog
Lock input run; check lease and seal first candidate
Return diagnostic without retaining partial data
Stop; no fallback to current data
